C0707.title: World's First AIGC Platform Infringement Case Verdict
C0707.summary: On February 8, 2024, the Guangzhou Internet Court issued a ruling in the world's first AIGC platform infringement case, determining that a generative AI platform was involved in infringement during content generation. This case provides a judicial precedent for the liability boundaries of AIGC service providers concerning the infringement of others' rights by AI-generated content.

references.title: AIGC Platform Found Liable for Infringement! Businesses Need Not Panic - Analysis of the 'World's First Generative AI' Ruling
